Yes, you can! Leafy Plus has a **14-day full refund window** if you cancel within 14 days of purchase **and** haven't used any benefits. Since you're at 20 days, you're unfortunately just outside that window—refunds are only available within the 14-day period.

However, your membership benefits continue through the end of your paid year, so you can still use them (free Standard shipping, free change-of-mind returns, 90-day guarantee, etc.). Would you like me to escalate this to a Support Lead to review your specific situation?
